recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a double-exposure effect where a joyful portrait of a man is blended with a vibrant blue and orange sunset sky. The portrait is centered in the lower half, while the upper half contains layered typography and a thin white border framing the entire scene.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait transparency reveals underlying sky textures
Horizontal text block balances the verticality of the portrait
Bright lens flare on the right side interacts with the subject's face
Thin white border contains the atmospheric elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered portrait in the lower two-thirds, scaled to show head and shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's bright, open-mouthed smile and eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central portrait, moves upward to the large display text, then to the smaller top-aligned text, and finally follows the lens flare rays.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample sky space in the top third for typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue sky providing the primary background tone.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm orange and gold sunset clouds at the bottom and right edges.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the main title and border for maximum legibility.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues; high value (brightness) in the lens flare and teeth.
paletteRestrictions: Deep brown/black for hair and shadows

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses ultra-light stroke weights
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; focus on extreme tracking and thinness
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, thin geometric sans and a fluid, expressive script.
graphicDevices: Thin white square frame inset from the edges

preserve: Hairline weight of the main title
avoid: Opaque portrait layers that hide the sky

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, thin, uppercase aesthetic of the main title.
Matches the casual, angled signature style at the top.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a double exposure image. The base is a high-contrast portrait of a smiling Black man with a beard. The overlay is a vibrant blue sky with wispy white and orange sunset clouds. Use a 'Screen' or 'Lighten' blend mode so the sky textures appear inside the man's silhouette. Add a bright white lens flare on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin white square border. Center a large title in a hairline sans-serif font in all caps. Above that, add a secondary name in a bold sans-serif, and top it with a signature-style script font angled slightly upwards.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait blended with the sky textures?
Is the main title font extremely thin and uppercase?
Is there a thin white border framing the composition?
Does the lens flare appear to wash out part of the image?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the double exposure blend
Color temperature of the sunset clouds
Tracking width of the display text
mustRedesign: Unique facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Seamless blending between portrait and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the sky
Check that the double exposure doesn't lose the subject's expression
Verify the border is perfectly centered and square
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a joyful portrait with an atmospheric landscape using double exposure, framed by a thin geometric border and topped with ultra-thin uppercase typography.
